name: Gabler Group AG
summary: Gabler Group AG engages in the manufacturing of subsea solutions for exploration, development, understanding, and securing the underwater domain. The firm serves the defense, offshore energy, and ocean science markets. It operates through the following segments: Submarine Systems, Underwater Communication and Data, Underwater Power Generation, and Thermoforming. The Submarine Systems segment offers mast systems, externally developed communications buoys, and torpedo-tube-launched surveillance and strike platforms. The Thermoforming segment is involved in the manufacturing of machines for plastic packaging for the food sector. The company was founded by Ulrich Gabler on July 17, 1962 and is headquartered in Germany.
